mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate trend is downward.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC is negative in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust economic demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST show positive growth, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.5%) trigger central bank tightening that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC is negative in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects weakening manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1300.0 thousand units signal strong consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1300.0, or the Rank IC is negative in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) combined with stable federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS <= 3.0%) indicates a healthy labor market without monetary tightening, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market expansion with stable rates
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0 and FEDFUNDS <= 3.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (RSAFS growth > 5.0% annually) indicates economic overcapacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is negative in a 3-year rolling window.
